name: Gmail (estimating inboxes)
purpose: Primary intake pipe. Every ITB, addendum, award notice and GC question arrives here first. Feeds the daily ITB intake job and the project auto-create flow.

auth.notes: App password lives in .env (git-ignored). See .env.example. The Claude-side Gmail MCP connector is authorised separately in connector settings.

access.search_query: ("invitation to bid" OR "invite to bid" OR "bid invitation" OR ITB OR "request for proposal" OR "request to bid" OR "bids due" OR demolition) newer_than:2d -in:sent -in:draft

known_limits: App passwords require 2-Step Verification on the Google account.
IMAP body parsing is HTML-heavy for platform blasts; plaintext fallback is lossy on tables.
Gmail thread search returns whole threads when any one message matches, so already-submitted bids surface and must be filtered.
